text_block_list.name: Cosmetics Store Clerk
text_block_list.text: Only 5 lucky bags left! Just 5 remaining!

text_block_list.name: Clothing Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Our flash sale is starting soon!
Buy two items at 70% off
and get an additional 10% off!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haaah, it really feels like the New Year, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should buy something on the way home~
Then again, money's pretty tight this month...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I wanna go shopping.
I wanna get in on those sweet deals too.”
choice_data_list: Then shall we go look at some training gear?
Then shall we go check out some training gear?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, Trainer?
No, no, not in such
a serious way~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after buying training gear at a great discount
with Hishi Miracle—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ooh, a lottery raffle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
didn't we get the tickets just now?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Let's bet on that~
At least 3rd prize. I wanna go home feeling happy~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I lined up for the lottery with Hishi Miracle.
And when our turn arrived...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle eagerly
turned the raffle wheel's crank!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
...What?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hot springs! It's hot springs time!
Trainer, hot springs!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Did you see the name of the inn?
It's a super famous place!
It was even on TV the other day...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The reviews are 5-star too!
The night view from the room is top-notch,
and the food is supervised by a famous chef~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her eyes sparkle as she talks excitedly.
The hot springs trip will surely be the ultimate reward."
choice_data_list: How about we go if we work hard this year, then?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeees, this year—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: This year only just started, though...?
choice_data_list: I'm counting on your hard work "this year".
I'm counting on your hard work "this year".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh.
So what happens if I can't do my best...?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, so mean~.
You're a demon, a monster, pool teacher~...
choice_data_list: But if you give it your all, you'll get a dedicated recovery period afterwards

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Please give me at least 5 days off, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Two days to prepare before leaving,
and two days to lounge around after getting back.
I'm not compromising on that.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Understood.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Are you absolutely sure~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I write down her vacation plans in the notebook I use for race schedules.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because by the time this year ends,
she'll surely have worked so hard
that you'll want to give her plenty of time off.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, yahooo!
It's first prize! First priiize!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa. My luck might be insane today.
Wanna try another raffle?"
choice_data_list: We might be able to ride this wave as we are.
We might be able to ride this wave as we are.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh~, you really get it,
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Shall we go buy some dreams, then?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Young lady! You forgot your prize!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Whoopsie.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, so sorry about that... Please excuse me, thank you, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I accompanied Hishi Miracle as she cheerfully browsed the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, all the scratch cards were losers too—?
Are you kidding me—?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh, if it's come to this—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Shall we head back?
We've got carrot hamburg steaks waiting, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after returning to her room, Hishi Miracle
munch-munched happily on her delicious hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, whoa. Amazing!
That's a ton of food.
choice_data_list: Are you going to share with someone?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, indeed.
That might actually be a viable option.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
For now, I think I'll take some to my classmates
and my friends.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I thought I handed out quite a few.
Still nowhere near done... *sigh*

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No more today, though, I'm spent.
I'm wiped out, so timeout for a break...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The bed is so fluffy~.
Pure bliss~..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrr~...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, my tummy's growling...
But even walking to the cafeteria is—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: So this was for times like this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later on, Hishi Miracle reported back
that the mountain of carrots came in very handy.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wow. It hit!
I did it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you, thank you.
I got a little lucky, is all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If I try again with this momentum,
don't you think I might win an even better prize?
choice_data_list: You might end up drawing a dud, you know.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Whoa, that's super likely.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well then, to finish on a good note,
shall we call it a day here?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Well, stuff like this is usually just
tissues or candy, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Still, it's a dud, huh? *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Hishi Miracle stood there,
slumping her shoulders in defeat...
